mapper.sql: customer_id, tenant_id, customer_name, customer_type, customer_status, customer_source, owner_employee_id, contact_phone, contact_email, contact_address, industry, company_scale, annual_revenue, website, description, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, is_deleted

choose.when: SELECT customer_source as name, COUNT(*) as count FROM customer WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY customer_source ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT customer_type as name, COUNT(*) as count FROM customer WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY customer_type ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT industry as name, COUNT(*) as count FROM customer WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND industry IS NOT NULL GROUP BY industry ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT customer_status as name, COUNT(*) as count FROM customer WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY customer_status ORDER BY count DESC
choose.otherwise: SELECT customer_source as name, COUNT(*) as count FROM customer WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY customer_source ORDER BY count DESC

mapper.update: UPDATE customer SET owner_employee_id = #{newOwnerEmployeeId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.customer_type, c.owner_employee_id, e.name as ownerEmployeeName, MAX(f.follow_time) as lastFollowTime, DATEDIFF(NOW(), MAX(f.follow_time)) as daysSinceLastFollow FROM customer c LEFT JOIN customer_follow f ON c.customer_id = f.customer_id LEFT JOIN employee e ON c.owner_employee_id = e.id WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.customer_status = 'confirmed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.customer_type, c.owner_employee_id, e.name HAVING daysSinceLastFollow > #{daysSinceLastFollow} ORDER BY daysSinceLastFollow DESC
